listen_address.description: IP address E2Guardian listens on for incoming HTTP proxy requests.

listen_port.description: Port number E2Guardian listens on (typically 8080 or 3128).

daemon_nodaemon.description: If true, runs in foreground (useful for debugging or containerized deployments).

children_count.description: Number of child processes to spawn for handling requests.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity: 1 (error) to 5 (trace). Level 3 is recommended for production.

log_ip_addresses.description: Include client IP addresses in log entries.

log_file_path.description: Path to the main access log file.

banned_mime_types.description: List of MIME types to block (e.g., scripts, executables).

content_group_files.description: Paths to content restriction files (defines allowed/disallowed categories).

auth_module.description: Authentication module: 'basic', 'digest', or custom module name.

auth_file.description: Path to the file containing valid usernames/passwords.

auth_realm.description: Authentication realm string shown in browser login prompt.

auth_type.description: Legacy alias for auth_enabled (use auth_enabled instead); kept for compatibility.

upstream_proxy_host.description: Hostname of upstream proxy to forward requests to (empty = direct internet access).

time_restrictions_enabled.description: Enable time-based content filtering (e.g., block during work hours).

restricted_times.description: Time ranges (24h, comma-separated) when restrictions apply.

url_length_limit.description: Maximum allowed URL length in bytes (to prevent buffer overflow attacks).

phrase_group_files.description: Paths to phrase blacklist files (contains prohibited words/phrases).

pattern_group_files.description: Paths to regex pattern files (only active if pattern_matching_enabled=true).

exclude_ips.description: IPs/CIDRs to exempt from filtering, each with optional comment.

exclude_domains.description: Domains to exempt from filtering, each with optional comment.

language.description: Language for filtered-page banners and error messages.

ssl_inspection_enabled.description: Enable HTTPS traffic inspection (MITM). Requires valid SSL certificate.

ssl_cert_file.description: Path to SSL certificate for MITM inspection.

ssl_chain_file.description: Path to intermediate CA certificate chain (optional).

ssl_proxy_port.description: Port used for SSL-inspected traffic (if enabled).

max_content_download_mb.description: Maximum size (MB) to download for content analysis before blocking.

max_content_download_limit_mb.description: Absolute hard limit (MB) for download size — requests above this are aborted.

max_request_size_kb.description: Maximum HTTP request size (KB) allowed (headers + method + URL).

max_body_size_kb.description: Maximum HTTP POST body size (KB) allowed.

max_connect_time_s.description: Maximum seconds to wait for upstream connection before timing out.

cache_path.description: Directory path for cached content (requires write permissions).

cache_limit_mb.description: Maximum cache size in MB (if caching is enabled).
